text: Oh, my God. No, that can't be.
You are a slow glob of prototasm.
What you see now is an electrical projection.
A manifestation of my hatred's life.
My body, my human body, is in there.
It is a twisted, wretched mess
kept alive by the cannibalized body parts of corpses.
Those amorphous things just go about their lives all around me.
Combining, recombining, playing with the monstrous things that mourn against them.
Are you? Are you sorry that my body is a sickening apparition?
Are you sorry that I haven't slept for twenty years?
I've been awake, Curtis. Watching you. Building my powers so that I can smash you, destroy you, take your life the way you took mine.
